entities.name: Iname
entities.description: Kami of life and death on Kamigawa, with a life aspect and a death aspect.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane whose mortal races Iname's creation led to.

entities.name: The Child
entities.description: First kami Child, created by Iname, who became the first kami of flowers; killed by Iname.

events.summary: Iname creates the first kami Child and becomes the kami of life.
events.quote: the first kami Child since the beginning of time was born

events.summary: Iname and the Child populate a distant planet with life.
events.quote: eventually locating a distant planet and populating it with life

events.summary: Iname kills the Child when it tries to leave, revealing his aspect as the kami of death.
events.quote: Iname killed it, revealing his second aspect as the kami of death

relations.note: Molded it and lent his life force.
relations.quote: he lent just a touch of his kami life force to his creation
Iname killed it, revealing his second aspect as the kami of death
